_meta.description: Cardmaster subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: crit, accuracy, spell damage.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la chance de critique de 0.8% et les degats critiques de 0.8% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases crit chance by 0.8% and crit damage by 0.8% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la precision de 1% et la MAG de 0.8% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases accuracy by 1% and MAG by 0.8% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente les degats de sorts de 1.5% et le Souffle max de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases spell damage by 1.5% and max Breath by 0.5% per level.
